scope: Native full-clear init and init thunk over all byte fills; pinned no-lock write skip/trim/invalid modes, wrap and blocking mode with sufficient free space on two channels
limitations: Blocked writes awaiting debugger consumption and concurrent host/device accesses are not tested.
SDK generic initializer differs and is excluded; native reverse-identifier bytes and copy order are source-owned; original compiler instruction identity remains unproven.
Other SEGGER wrappers/read API bodies, whole-image startup/linking, physical debugger behavior and byte equality remain gates.
